title: Number of Recent Calls
statement: You have a request counter that records new requests (pings) and counts how many requests arrived in the past 3000 milliseconds. Each ping happens at a strictly increasing time t in milliseconds, and after recording it you report the number of pings that occurred in the inclusive range [t - 3000, t]. Adapted for this judge: instead of the stateful RecentCounter class, implement one batch call. Given the list of ping times in chronological order, return the list of counts, one per ping.
constraints: The count for ping t includes every ping in [t - 3000, t], the ping itself included

visibleExamples.explanation: At t=3001 the window is [1, 3001] and holds all three pings. At t=3002 the window is [2, 3002], so the ping at t=1 drops out and the ping at 3002 joins: still 3.
A gap of exactly 3000 keeps the older ping inside the window; a gap of 3001 pushes it out.
Every ping is more than 3000 ms after the previous one, so each window holds only itself.

hiddenCases.name: ping exactly 3000 apart is inside the window
ping 3001 apart falls outside the window
dense burst that overflows the window
every ping isolated by a long gap
